name: FlexiCubes
aliases: FlexiCubes Surface Extraction with Gradient-Based Optimization
Flexible Isosurface Extraction for Gradient-Based Mesh Optimization
definition: A high-quality isosurface representation designed for gradient-based mesh optimization with respect to geometric, visual, or physical objectives.
summary: FlexiCubes is a differentiable isosurface extraction method that converts signed distance fields into triangle meshes using learnable per-cube weights and vertex deformations to resolve topological ambiguities during gradient-based optimization.
